# sidecar.compute_assignment_weight { #healpyxel.sidecar.compute_assignment_weight }

```python
sidecar.compute_assignment_weight(
    src_geom,
    cell_geom,
    data_psf=None,
    cell_psf=None,
    combine_method='multiply',
    data_psf_sigma=None,
    cell_psf_sigma=None,
)
```

Compute the assignment weight for a (source geometry, cell geometry) pair.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type             | Description                                                                     | Default      |
|----------------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| src_geom       | shapely.geometry | Source geometry (e.g., FOV polygon).                                            | _required_   |
| cell_geom      | shapely.geometry | Target HEALPix cell geometry.                                                   | _required_   |
| data_psf       | callable or None | Optional data Point Spread Function. Called as ``data_psf(dx, dy)``.            | `None`       |
| cell_psf       | callable or None | Optional cell Point Spread Function. Called as ``cell_psf(dx, dy)``.            | `None`       |
| combine_method | str              | How to combine PSF weights: ``'multiply'``, ``'sum'``, ``'min'``, or ``'max'``. | `'multiply'` |
| data_psf_sigma | float or None    | Sigma parameter for the data PSF (if applicable).                               | `None`       |
| cell_psf_sigma | float or None    | Sigma parameter for the cell PSF (if applicable).                               | `None`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description            |
|--------|--------|------------------------|
|        | float  | Combined weight value. |
